presentation.title: Build Your Ideal Padel Trip to Spain
presentation.heroAlt: Padel players on court in Spain
presentation.desc: Whether you're a padel club, community, group of friends or event organiser, we'll create a personalised Spanish padel experience around your group.

whyTravel.title: Why Travel with Vibra?
whyTravel.intro: More than a padel trip, we create unforgettable group experiences that combine top-level padel coaching with authentic Spain.
benefits: Stress-free planning from start to finish

builtAroundYou.title: Every Trip is Built Around You
builtAroundYou.intro: No fixed packages. No one-size-fits-all itineraries. Every Vibra trip is designed around your group's goals, budget and travel style.
options: Range of padel clubs and experiences

whatsIncluded.title: What's Included?
whatsIncluded.intro: Every itinerary is different, but your trip can include:

designedAround.title: Designed Around Your Group
designedAround.description: Every Vibra itinerary is unique. Blend exceptional padel with authentic Spanish experiences to create the perfect balance of sport, culture, relaxation, and adventure.

schedule.titleLine1: Get a taste of what your Vibra
schedule.day1i1: AM: Fly to destination, seamless transfer to hotel, settle in, unpack and relax.
schedule.day1i2: 17:00 - 19:00: Kickstart your trip with a group padel coaching session
schedule.day1i3: 19:00: Welcome drinks at the Padel club.
schedule.day2i4: 12:00 - 17:30: Unique cultural experience afternoon or enjoy free time to get lunch, relax or explore your surroundings
schedule.day4i2: 10:00 - 12:00: Americano style competition with local club members.

makeItYours.subtitle: Enhance your Padel holiday by adding a touch of adventure, wellness, or local culture. Mix and match based on your group's interests.

culture.title: Vineyard tour, wine tasting & tapas
culture.description: Tour a local vineyard near Barcelona or Sevilla, learn about winemaking, and sample unique local grape varieties. Enjoy a curated wine tasting with panoramic countryside views followed by local tapas at the vineyard.

culture.title: La Liga Matchday Experience
culture.description: Watch a live La Liga match featuring FC Barcelona, Espanyol, Sevilla FC or Real Betis. Subject to fixtures and availability.

culture.title: Tapas Tour
culture.description: A guided tapas tasting tour through the most authentic local neighbourhood bars. Discover hidden gems as you sample regional delicacies, traditional dishes, and classic Spanish drinks, just like the locals do.

culture.title: Flamenco Show (Sevilla Only)
culture.description: Experience the power and passion of live flamenco in an intimate setting, an unforgettable cultural experience unique to Andalucia.

culture.title: Food Market & Cooking Class
culture.description: Guided visit to a bustling local food market followed by a hands-on cooking class. Learn to prepare local dishes with expert guidance and enjoy a true taste of the region.

sports.title: Round of Golf
sports.description: Play at a picturesque golf course near the city. Includes transfers, equipment rental, and optional drinks or dinner at the clubhouse.

sports.title: Sunrise or Sunset Guided Running Tour
sports.description: Discover the magic of Barcelona or Sevilla with passionate local running guides on a scenic city run, the perfect way to energize your morning or unwind at sunset. Typically 10km, but both distance and pace can be tailored to suit your group.

sports.title: Kayaking Adventure
sports.description: Paddle along Barcelona's coastline or through Sevilla's historic riverfront. Guided or independent options available. Stand up paddle-boarding (SUP) also available.

relax.title: Sunrise or Sunset Yoga
relax.description: Outdoor yoga sessions in serene settings, ideal for stretching out and resetting your body post-padel.

relax.title: Sunrise or Sunset Pilates
relax.description: Guided pilates in the open air to strengthen, stretch, and reconnect with your breath.

relax.title: Spa & Wellness Session
relax.description: Unwind after padel with a massage, spa treatment, or beauty service tailored to your needs.
